title: Visual Hierarchy and Spacing
intro: One primary thing per view. Group by spacing before you reach for a border.

learn.title: Three levels
learn.text:
**Primary:** the main action or information, one per view.
**Secondary:** supporting content.
**Tertiary:** metadata and hints.

When everything is bold, nothing is.

try.q: How many primary actions per view?
try.explain: One filled primary button; others are outlined or text.

learn.title: Weight and colour first
learn.text:
Make secondary text **lighter grey** or **lighter weight** before making it smaller.

Visual emphasis and HTML structure are separate: an h2 doesn’t have to be big.

try.q: A label competes with the value next to it. First fix?
options: Make the label a lighter grey
Put a border around the value
Move the label into a tooltip
try.explain: De-emphasise the supporting part before enlarging the main one.

learn.title: A spacing scale
learn.text:
Base unit **4 or 8 px**: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 96.

Forms: 4 px input to help text, 8 px label to input, **24 px between groups.**

try.q: Why space from a fixed scale?
options: It loads faster in the browser
It removes the need for grids
try.explain: Values that grow apart stop near-identical gaps.

learn.title: Squint test
learn.text:
Start with **too much whitespace**, then remove.

Blur your eyes: related items should merge into one shape, separate groups should stay apart. Space between groups must be larger than space inside them.

try.q: What should the squint test show?
options: Related items merge, groups stay apart

test.q: A secondary action should usually be:
options: A link inside the page title
test.explain: Only the primary action is filled.

test.q: A layout feels cramped. Best way to start?
options: Shrink the font sizes a little
test.explain: Removing space from an airy layout works better than squeezing more in.

options: A background change or more space
A thicker font for the label
A coloured icon in each corner
A drop shadow on every item
A data table for daily users
An empty state with one action
Set by the length of the labels
test.explain: Otherwise a label sits as close to the wrong field.
